proposition: The dissertation says the Turka family was sent to Temür's court at Samarkand in 789/1387, that Ibn Turka left c. 795/1393 for Mecca and Cairo with Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī, studied in Cairo about fifteen years (c. 795-810/1393-1408), and returned to Isfahan c. 810/1408; MK warns that some timeline dates are conjectured or approximate.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I 170, II 203
mediation.note: the fifteen-year period is reported through the apologies
